headline: Eagles agree to trade A.J. Brown to Patriots for 2 draft picks
description: The Eagles are trading star wide receiver A.J. Brown to the Patriots for a first-round draft pick in 2028 and a 2027 fifth-round pick.

headline: Browns trade Myles Garrett to Rams for Jared Verse, three picks
description: The Browns have traded Myles Garrett to the Rams for Jared Verse and multiple draft picks, including a 2027 first-rounder.
